Legal & Transparency

Privacy Policy

Last Updated: October 2026  |  Ellora Spaces

At Ellora Spaces, we curate architectural surfaces, designer tiles, and artisanal wallpaper with reverence for natural materiality, refined aesthetics, and timeless craft. Just as we care for the spaces you inhabit, we are committed to safeguarding your personal privacy across every touchpoint of our online gallery and concierge services.

1. Information We Collect

When you explore our collections, request material swatch samples, or place an order, we collect the necessary information to fulfill your requests:

  • Personal Identifiers: Full name, billing address, site/shipping address, email address, and phone number.
  • Order & Transaction Records: Tile and wallpaper collections chosen, project dimensions, sample requests, and payment receipts (payment card credentials are encrypted and processed directly via PCI-DSS certified gateways and never stored on our servers).
  • Architectural & Trade Inquiries: Floor plans, CAD drawings, design notes, and studio specifications shared with our trade consultants.
  • Device & Browsing Analytics: IP address, browser type, device information, and interaction paths across our gallery rooms.

2. How We Use Your Data

We treat your personal details with deliberate care. Your information is used strictly to:

  • Safely dispatch and deliver sample swatch boxes and palletized freight shipments to your residence or project site.
  • Provide trade concierge assistance, order status tracking, and architectural material recommendations.
  • Issue tax invoices and verify trade accounts for architects and interior designers.
  • Send our journal, Notes on Materials, Interiors & Atmosphere, only when you have explicitly joined our mailing circle.
  • Optimize site performance, responsive layout, and catalog search speeds.

3. Third Parties & Service Providers

Ellora Spaces will never monetize, sell, or trade your personal data with third-party advertising brokers.

We share details solely with essential infrastructure partners:

  • Store Infrastructure: Shopify Inc., providing database and encrypted checkout systems.
  • Logistics & Freight: Dedicated white-glove pallet carriers and courier dispatch networks.
  • Payment Processors: Certified gateways (Shopify Payments, Stripe, Apple Pay) operating under bank-grade security.
All service partners are strictly bounded by non-disclosure and security protocols in compliance with international privacy regulations.

4. Cookies & Tracking Technologies

We employ essential and performance cookies to remember your curated shopping bag, active sessions, and local currency preferences. You may configure or disable cookies through your browser settings at any time without limiting catalog browsing.

5. Your Privacy Rights

Regardless of your location, you hold complete rights over your personal data. You are entitled to:

  • Access & Portability: Request a full copy of the personal information stored in your client record.
  • Rectification: Correct or update any project delivery details or contact data.
  • Erasure: Request the deletion of your account and personal records, subject to statutory tax and financial record-keeping laws.
  • Opt-Out: Unsubscribe from marketing dispatches at any time via the link at the bottom of our emails.

6. Contact Us

If you have any questions or wish to submit a privacy request, our concierge team is readily available:

Ellora Spaces Client Concierge

Email: care@elloraspaces.com

Trade Desk: trade@elloraspaces.com

Studio: Ellora Spaces Design Studio, India

Response Time: Within 1 to 2 business days
